summary: Promisify a standard Node error-first callback function when no util.promisify.custom override is present.

target.notes: Reuse existing function/Promise helpers. Preserve wrapper this-binding and callback argument ordering.

semantics.callback_contract: last callback uses first argument as error and second as fulfillment value
semantics.success: otherwise fulfills with the callback value

caveats: Promisifying functions that already return Promises is deprecated in modern Node.
Non-standard multiple-success-argument APIs may require custom promisify behavior.
